title: Challenge 1: Create Superposition |+⟩
storyScenario: Chef Quantum needs to initialize a single photon qubit into an equal superposition coin flip to generate unbiased random numbers.
description: Transform Qubit 0 from ground state |0⟩ into equal superposition state |+⟩ = (|0⟩ + |1⟩)/√2 under strict gate bounds.

starterCode.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def build_circuit():
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # Place your gate here
    qc.h(0)
    return qc
starterCode.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit(0)
circuit = cirq.Circuit(cirq.H(q))

testCases.name: Hidden: Positive Phase Re(α) = Re(β)
testCases.assertion: Phase angle θ = 0 (Plus state, not Minus state)

editorial.mathematicalProof: The Hadamard matrix H = (1/√2)[[1, 1], [1, -1]] transforms basis vector [1, 0]ᵀ into [1/√2, 1/√2]ᵀ = |+⟩.
editorial.algorithmicAnalysis: A single elementary unitary gate creates continuous quantum superposition in O(1) time.

hints: Apply a single Hadamard (H) gate to Qubit 0.
The Hadamard gate rotates the state vector 90 degrees around the Y+Z diagonal on the Bloch sphere.
